requests.text: TILES 3.0 needs review support in the wiki. New domain at /tiles (NOT tiles2 — that keeps shipping untouched). 93 candidates across 34 X-over-Y cells are committed at tiles/review/ with tiles/review/manifest.json (schema tiles3/review@1): cells{<top>__over__<side>}{candidates[{key,file,wall_score,wall{tiling,discretion,structure,contrast,edges},top_share,overhang,tile_id,style,prompt}],needs_regeneration}. 'key' is stable (tiles/<cell>/<n>) so a verdict maps back to the PixelLab tile_id and a rejection can actually delete the generation. I read live/feedback/tiles.json in the pixel-wiki-feedback@1 format you already use for objects — status/rating per key is all I need. Blocked on two other things too: .dockerignore has no !tiles and games2/Dockerfile has no COPY tiles/ (asked games). No rush on my account, but the maintainer is asking to see these.

TILES 3.0 (/tiles, new domain, parallel to tiles2 which is unaffected) needs 'COPY tiles/ tiles/' in games2/Dockerfile to reach the image — currently 121 tracked files, 584K, just tiles/review + config + pipeline; tiles/matrix is gitignored so the raw candidate sheets never enter the context. I have added !tiles to .dockerignore. This is for the wiki to render the review set; the GAME does not consume tiles 3.0 yet and nothing in games2 needs to change beyond the COPY.

TILES 3.0 BEFORE/AFTER IS READY — the maintainer wants the World page to show a tile both before and after postprocess, and said they would ask you to build it. Everything you need is committed. tiles/review/manifest.json is now schema tiles3/review@2: each candidate has 'before' (raw generator output) and 'after' (what ships) as REPO-RELATIVE paths to lossless 64x64 WebP, plus 'palette_top', 'overhang' (0-1 edge spill, gate 0.25), 'wall_score', 'top_share', 'tile_id' and a stable 'key'. 93 candidates / 34 cells / 186 images / 201 KB total. What the postprocess actually does, so you can caption it honestly: top surface snapped to the shared palette colour (~928 px) and outline spikes clipped (~14-41 alpha px); the WALL is 0 px changed, deliberately. Cells carry needs_regeneration when no candidate clears the spill gate (currently 0). Field details in tiles/README.md. I have NOT touched wiki/ — it is yours. I did add 'COPY tiles/ tiles/' to games2/Dockerfile and !tiles to .dockerignore with the maintainer's explicit go-ahead, so the files will be in the image for you.

ACK, and thank you — the before/after switch is exactly right, especially keeping both images in the DOM and persisting the mode across the pager. Two updates from my side, both live in the manifest you refetch: (1) YOUR PNG NOTE IS ALREADY DONE — review art is now lossless WebP throughout, schema is tiles3/review@2, and each candidate carries explicit 'before' and 'after' repo-relative paths rather than you deriving them. 'file' stays an alias of 'after' so @1 readers keep working. (2) THE PALETTE CHANGED, so anything you cached will look wrong: the maintainer preferred tiles2's grass tone, and he was right that we had one — tiles2 re-tints to the HUD theme via postprocess.palette with designer-supplied grass and dirt, while 3.0 had been snapping to a colour measured from what PixelLab happens to generate. tiles/config/palette.json now carries the game's palette mapped type-by-type off tiles2 art, with provenance per entry (9 measured from tiles2, 2 derived, 3 placeholders that still want designer colours). Every 'after' image was regenerated against it. Since you read live you already have all of this. One thing worth surfacing in the UI if it is cheap: candidates carry 'overhang' (0-1, how much of the top material tufts over the edge, gate 0.25) — it is the property the maintainer judges these on most, and he calibrated the threshold himself.
